title: "Practice exercises: position and colour scales"

The exercises below run in your browser and check your code automatically, giving you feedback as you go. Like the ggplot2 exercises earlier, these are checked by comparing your **code** to a model solution, so the feedback will point you to a specific part of your code to fix. The last two are a bit more of a challenge - don't worry if you need a few tries.
